subject: Mahindra Scorpio-N

specs.name: power_petrol
specs.source_sentence: The Scorpio-N's 2.0-litre turbo-petrol makes 203 PS of power and 370 Nm (MT) / 380 Nm (AT).

specs.name: power_diesel
specs.source_sentence: The 2.2-litre mHawk diesel makes up to 175 PS.

specs.name: torque_diesel
specs.source_sentence: The 2.2-litre diesel produces 370 Nm (MT) / 400 Nm (AT) of torque.

specs.name: drivetrain
specs.source_sentence: The Scorpio-N offers 4XPLOR four-wheel drive with 4-Low and 4-High and terrain modes for snow, sand and mud.

specs.name: adas
specs.source_sentence: The top Z8L variant gets full Level 2 ADAS.

specs.name: audio
specs.source_sentence: The Z8L features a Sony 3D 12-speaker audio system.

specs.name: airbags
specs.source_sentence: Six airbags are offered from the Z8S variant onwards.

specs.name: sunroof
specs.source_sentence: The Scorpio-N is offered with a single-pane sunroof.

specs.name: seating
specs.source_sentence: The Scorpio-N is available in 6- and 7-seat configurations.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: Claimed mileage ranges from 12.12 to 15.94 kmpl across variants.

specs.name: body_type
specs.source_sentence: The Scorpio-N is a body-on-frame (ladder-frame) SUV.

_source_note: India facts from CarDekho + Mahindra. Owner CarDekho-verifies power/price at Gate 1. ADAS/Sony/6-airbags are TOP-variant (Z8L/Z8S) — do not imply they exist on the base.
